task.description: Run the FULL project test suite (not just REQ-202's own files), plus mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix format --check-formatted, and mix letflow.check.test, per WF-02 Step 4.

result.summary: mix compile --warnings-as-errors: clean, no output. mix format --check-formatted: clean, no output. Full suite via scripts/test_parallel.sh (N=8, nproc): combined: 2861 tests, 6 properties, 6 failures (2861/2867 passed). Of the 6 failures: 2 are the documented rustc-absent Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest baseline (confirmed `which rustc`/`which cargo` both fail in this sandbox); 3 are a documented pre-existing Letflow.TenantSchemaReaperTest concurrency/connection-pool flake class under N=8 parallel load (same class as test/reports/report-2026-08-28-WF02-REQ165-20260828.yaml; test/support/tenant_schema_reaper_test.exs is not in this branch's diff -- structurally unrelated). The 6th is a GENUINE NEW REGRESSION this PR introduced: 'test C6 -- oracle-rot guard observed tables equal expected_tenant_tables/0 in both directions (Letflow.Support.TenantFixtureTest)' fails with 'a manifest migration created a table the oracle does not list: ["artifact_versions", "repository_artifacts"]'. REQ-202's migration (priv/repo/migrations/20260830030001_create_repository_artifacts.exs) creates both tables as tenant-scoped (prefix: schema, lines 68 and 82) but test/support/tenant_fixture.ex's @expected_tenant_tables oracle list (lines 122-150) was never updated -- confirmed via `git diff main...HEAD --stat` that test/support/tenant_fixture.ex is not among this branch's 27 changed files. This is the exact same recurring bug class documented on REQ-181 (webhook_subscriptions) and REQ-195 (audit_entries): every new tenant-scoped migration must add its table names to @expected_tenant_tables and bump the count assertion in the same PR. mix letflow.check.test did not complete within a 590s foreground timeout and was not retried given the blocking regression found; not reported on further, per the no-speculation rule.
